text:
devin: opened PR to add a tiny Console observability glossary + SQL exporter example and a few migration snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6001. Goals: clarify `unit_cost` vs legacy names, add PromQL + SQL exporter remap example, and a short tracing-hook normalization note.

anya: Nice. Quick request: add a one-line glossary table that maps old -> new metric names and what they mean (per-token, per-request, aggregated cost). Customers keep asking what's changed.

devin: Draft mapping added in PR: `console.cost_per_token` -> `console_unit_cost_total` (per-token cost rollup), `console.cost_per_request` -> `console_unit_cost_by_request`, and `console.cost_agg` -> `console_unit_cost_aggregate`. Kept short descriptions.

marc: For SQL exporter customers we should include a safe remap example (exported dashboard JSON to SQL dashboard rows). Quick idea: show how to update `expr` column in a sqlite dump or via a sed/perl one-liner.

devin: Added sed + perl variants:
```bash
# BSD-friendly (mac) using perl
cp -n exported exported-backup || true
perl -pi.bak -e "s/console.cost_per_token/console_unit_cost_total/g" exported/*.json
```
```bash
# GNU sed variant
sed -i.bak 's/console.cost_per_token/console_unit_cost_total/g' exported/*.json
```

anya: Also add a tiny SQL example showing how to transform an `expr` column in a sqlite DB for customers who store dashboards in SQL: 
```sql
-- backup first
VACUUM INTO 'dashboards_backup.db';
-- update expressions
UPDATE panels SET expr = replace(expr, 'console.cost_per_token', 'console_unit_cost_total') WHERE expr LIKE '%console.cost_per_token%';
```

marc: Great. Tracing note: runtime differences sometimes prefix trace IDs with `0x`. Add normalization examples for Python and Node and a short sentence about sampled traces underreporting attributed cost.

devin: Added examples: `trace_id = trace.id.hex(); if trace_id.startswith('0x'): trace_id = trace_id[2:]` and `const traceId = (trace.id || '').replace(/^0x/, '');`. Also added the sampling sentence.

doc-bot: Automated checks: linkchecker found 1 broken link (assets path). Lint: promql fence language suggested.

anya: I'll upload the missing image and fix the fence. assets-bot, can you put the panel screenshot in `/assets/images/docs/console/glossary/`?

assets-bot: created path /assets/images/docs/console/glossary and uploaded 1 file (cost-glossary-panel.png)

doc-bot: Re-run checks... linkcheck OK. Lint: promql fence fixed. CI: green.

marc: One more UX nit: add alt text to the panel image and a 1px contrast border for accessibility.

anya: Done (alt text + border). Also added a tiny smoke test query customers can run after remap: `sum(rate(console_unit_cost_total[5m])) by (service)` should return non-empty series for expected services.

devin: Perfect. I'll merge after staging preview. Thanks all!

devin: Merged and backported. Closing PR. Thanks everyone :tada:
